WITH filtered_orders AS ( SELECT ro.order_id, ro.status, ro.gross_order_amount, ro.customer_paid_amount, ro.provider_funded_discount
FROM report_orders ro
WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId}
AND ro.ordered_at >= #{from}
AND ro.ordered_at <= #{to}
AND ro.platform_type = #{platformType}
), completed_items_by_order AS ( SELECT fo.order_id,
COALESCE( SUM( ri.ordered_unit_price * ri.quantity ), 0 ) AS item_order_amount,
COALESCE( SUM( ri.menu_cost * ri.quantity ), 0 ) AS menu_cost,
COALESCE( SUM( ri.packaging_cost * ri.quantity ), 0 ) AS packaging_cost
FROM filtered_orders fo
INNER JOIN report_order_items ri ON ri.order_id = fo.order_id
WHERE fo.status IN ('DELIVERED', 'REFUNDED')
GROUP BY fo.order_id ), order_summary AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_order_count,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN fo.status IN ('DELIVERED', 'REFUNDED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS completed_order_count,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN fo.status = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS canceled_order_count,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN fo.status IN ('DELIVERED', 'REFUNDED') THEN COALESCE( fo.gross_order_amount, ci.item_order_amount, 0 ) ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS gross_order_amount,
SUM(CASE WHEN fo.status IN ('DELIVERED', 'REFUNDED') THEN fo.customer_paid_amount END) AS customer_paid_amount,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN fo.status IN ('DELIVERED', 'REFUNDED') THEN COALESCE(fo.provider_funded_discount, 0) ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS provider_funded_discount_amount
FROM filtered_orders fo
LEFT JOIN completed_items_by_order ci ON ci.order_id = fo.order_id ), completed_charges AS ( SELECT SUM(rc.amount) AS provider_charge_amount
FROM filtered_orders fo
INNER JOIN report_order_charges rc ON rc.order_id = fo.order_id
WHERE fo.status IN ('DELIVERED', 'REFUNDED') ), completed_item_totals AS ( SELECT COALESCE( SUM(menu_cost), 0 ) AS estimated_menu_cost,
COALESCE( SUM(packaging_cost), 0 ) AS estimated_packaging_cost
FROM completed_items_by_order ), refund_summary AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rr.amount), 0) AS customer_refund_amount, COALESCE(SUM(rr.merchant_liability_amount), 0) AS merchant_liability_amount, COALESCE(SUM(rr.platform_liability_amount), 0) AS platform_liability_amount FROM filtered_orders fo INNER JOIN report_refunds rr ON rr.order_id = fo.order_id WHERE fo.status = 'REFUNDED' AND rr.status = 'REFUNDED' ) SELECT os.total_order_count, os.completed_order_count, os.canceled_order_count, os.gross_order_amount, os.customer_paid_amount,
cc.provider_charge_amount,
os.provider_funded_discount_amount,
COALESCE( cit.estimated_menu_cost, 0 ) AS estimated_menu_cost,
COALESCE( cit.estimated_packaging_cost, 0 ) AS estimated_packaging_cost, rs.customer_refund_amount, rs.merchant_liability_amount, rs.platform_liability_amount
FROM order_summary os
CROSS JOIN completed_charges cc CROSS JOIN completed_item_totals cit CROSS JOIN refund_summary rs

SELECT order_id AS orderId, platform_type AS platformType, platform_order_id AS platformOrderId, status, ordered_at AS orderedAt, COALESCE( ro.gross_order_amount, ( SELECT SUM(ri.ordered_unit_price * ri.quantity) FROM report_order_items ri WHERE ri.order_id = ro.order_id ) ) AS grossOrderAmount, customer_paid_amount AS customerPaidAmount, provider_financial_data_status AS financialDataStatus
FROM report_orders ro
ORDER BY
grossOrderAmount
status
ordered_at
ASC
DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT ri.menu_id AS menuId, ri.menu_name AS menuName,
COUNT( DISTINCT ro.order_id ) AS orderCount,
COALESCE( SUM(ri.quantity), 0 ) AS soldQuantity,
COALESCE( SUM( ri.ordered_unit_price * ri.quantity ), 0 ) AS grossSales,
COALESCE( SUM( ri.menu_cost * ri.quantity ), 0 ) AS estimatedMenuCost,
COALESCE( SUM( ri.packaging_cost * ri.quantity ), 0 ) AS estimatedPackagingCost
FROM report_order_items ri
INNER JOIN report_orders ro ON ro.order_id = ri.order_id
WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId}
AND ro.status = 'DELIVERED'
AND ro.ordered_at >= #{from}
AND ro.ordered_at <= #{to}
AND ro.platform_type = #{platformType}
GROUP BY ri.menu_id, ri.menu_name
ORDER BY grossSales DESC, soldQuantity DESC, ri.menu_id ASC

WITH filtered_orders AS ( SELECT ro.order_id, ro.ordered_at, ro.status, COALESCE( ro.gross_order_amount, ( SELECT SUM(ri.ordered_unit_price * ri.quantity) FROM report_order_items ri WHERE ri.order_id = ro.order_id ) ) AS gross_order_amount, ro.customer_paid_amount, COALESCE(ro.provider_funded_discount, 0) AS provider_funded_discount, ro.provider_financial_data_status FROM report_orders ro WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId}
AND ro.ordered_at >= #{from}
AND ro.ordered_at <= #{to}
AND ro.platform_type = #{platformType}
), daily_orders AS ( SELECT DATE(ordered_at) AS reportDate,
COUNT(*) AS totalOrderCount,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN status IN ('DELIVERED', 'REFUNDED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS completedOrderCount,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS canceledOrderCount,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS refundedOrderCount,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN status IN ('DELIVERED', 'REFUNDED') THEN gross_order_amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS grossSales,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN status IN ('DELIVERED', 'REFUNDED') THEN customer_paid_amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS customerPaidAmount,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN status IN ('DELIVERED', 'REFUNDED') THEN provider_funded_discount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS providerFundedDiscountAmount,
GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN status IN ('DELIVERED', 'REFUNDED') THEN provider_financial_data_status ELSE NULL END ORDER BY provider_financial_data_status SEPARATOR ',' ) AS financialDataStatusesCsv
FROM filtered_orders GROUP BY DATE(ordered_at) ), daily_charges AS ( SELECT DATE(fo.ordered_at) AS reportDate,
COALESCE( SUM(rc.amount), 0 ) AS providerChargeAmount
FROM filtered_orders fo INNER JOIN report_order_charges rc ON rc.order_id = fo.order_id
WHERE fo.status IN ('DELIVERED', 'REFUNDED')
GROUP BY DATE(fo.ordered_at) ), daily_items AS ( SELECT DATE(fo.ordered_at) AS reportDate,
COALESCE( SUM( ri.menu_cost * ri.quantity ), 0 ) AS estimatedMenuCost,
COALESCE( SUM( ri.packaging_cost * ri.quantity ), 0 ) AS estimatedPackagingCost
FROM filtered_orders fo INNER JOIN report_order_items ri ON ri.order_id = fo.order_id
WHERE fo.status IN ('DELIVERED', 'REFUNDED')
GROUP BY DATE(fo.ordered_at) ), daily_refunds AS ( SELECT DATE(fo.ordered_at) AS reportDate,
COALESCE( SUM(rr.merchant_liability_amount), 0 ) AS merchantLiabilityAmount
FROM filtered_orders fo INNER JOIN report_refunds rr ON rr.order_id = fo.order_id
WHERE fo.status = 'REFUNDED' AND rr.status = 'REFUNDED'
GROUP BY DATE(fo.ordered_at) ) SELECT d.reportDate, d.totalOrderCount, d.completedOrderCount, d.canceledOrderCount, d.refundedOrderCount, d.grossSales, d.customerPaidAmount,
COALESCE( c.providerChargeAmount, 0 ) AS providerChargeAmount,
d.providerFundedDiscountAmount,
COALESCE( i.estimatedMenuCost, 0 ) AS estimatedMenuCost,
COALESCE( i.estimatedPackagingCost, 0 ) AS estimatedPackagingCost,
COALESCE( r.merchantLiabilityAmount, 0 ) AS merchantLiabilityAmount,
d.financialDataStatusesCsv
FROM daily_orders d LEFT JOIN daily_charges c ON c.reportDate = d.reportDate LEFT JOIN daily_items i ON i.reportDate = d.reportDate LEFT JOIN daily_refunds r ON r.reportDate = d.reportDate
ORDER BY d.reportDate ASC

SELECT ro.order_id AS orderId, ro.platform_type AS platformType, ro.external_store_id AS externalStoreId, ro.provider_financial_data_status AS financialDataStatus, ro.gross_order_amount AS orderGrossAmount, ro.provider_funded_discount AS providerFundedDiscount, ri.menu_id AS menuId, ri.menu_name AS menuName, ri.quantity AS quantity, COALESCE(ri.ordered_unit_price * ri.quantity, 0) AS grossSales, COALESCE(ri.menu_cost * ri.quantity, 0) AS costOfGoods, COALESCE(ri.packaging_cost * ri.quantity, 0) AS packagingCost FROM report_orders ro INNER JOIN report_order_items ri ON ri.order_id = ro.order_id WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId} AND ro.status = 'DELIVERED' AND ro.ordered_at >= #{from} AND ro.ordered_at <= #{to} AND ro.platform_type = #{platformType} ORDER BY ro.order_id ASC, ri.menu_id ASC, ri.menu_name ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS completedOrderCount,
COUNT( CASE WHEN ro.ordered_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at >= ro.ordered_at THEN 1 END ) AS totalProcessingSampleCount,
CAST( ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ro.ordered_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at >= ro.ordered_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, ro.ordered_at, ro.completed_at ) END ) ) AS SIGNED ) AS averageTotalProcessingSeconds,
COUNT( CASE WHEN ro.ordered_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.cooking_started_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.cooking_started_at >= ro.ordered_at THEN 1 END ) AS waitingSampleCount,
CAST( ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ro.ordered_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.cooking_started_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.cooking_started_at >= ro.ordered_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, ro.ordered_at, ro.cooking_started_at ) END ) ) AS SIGNED ) AS averageWaitingSeconds,
COUNT( CASE WHEN ro.cooking_started_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.ready_for_pickup_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.ready_for_pickup_at >= ro.cooking_started_at THEN 1 END ) AS cookingSampleCount,
CAST( ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ro.cooking_started_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.ready_for_pickup_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.ready_for_pickup_at >= ro.cooking_started_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, ro.cooking_started_at, ro.ready_for_pickup_at ) END ) ) AS SIGNED ) AS averageCookingSeconds,
COUNT( CASE WHEN ro.ready_for_pickup_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.picked_up_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.picked_up_at >= ro.ready_for_pickup_at THEN 1 END ) AS pickupWaitingSampleCount,
CAST( ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ro.ready_for_pickup_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.picked_up_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.picked_up_at >= ro.ready_for_pickup_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, ro.ready_for_pickup_at, ro.picked_up_at ) END ) ) AS SIGNED ) AS averagePickupWaitingSeconds,
COUNT( CASE WHEN ro.picked_up_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at >= ro.picked_up_at THEN 1 END ) AS deliverySampleCount,
CAST( ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ro.picked_up_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at >= ro.picked_up_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, ro.picked_up_at, ro.completed_at ) END ) ) AS SIGNED ) AS averageDeliverySeconds
FROM report_orders ro
WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId}
AND ro.operation_status = 'COMPLETED'
AND ro.ordered_at >= #{from}
AND ro.ordered_at <= #{to}
AND ro.platform_type = #{platformType}

SELECT ro.platform_type AS platformType,
COUNT(*) AS completedOrderCount,
COUNT( CASE WHEN ro.ordered_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at >= ro.ordered_at THEN 1 END ) AS totalProcessingSampleCount,
CAST( ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ro.ordered_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at >= ro.ordered_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, ro.ordered_at, ro.completed_at ) END ) ) AS SIGNED ) AS averageTotalProcessingSeconds,
COUNT( CASE WHEN ro.ordered_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.cooking_started_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.cooking_started_at >= ro.ordered_at THEN 1 END ) AS waitingSampleCount,
CAST( ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ro.ordered_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.cooking_started_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.cooking_started_at >= ro.ordered_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, ro.ordered_at, ro.cooking_started_at ) END ) ) AS SIGNED ) AS averageWaitingSeconds,
COUNT( CASE WHEN ro.cooking_started_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.ready_for_pickup_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.ready_for_pickup_at >= ro.cooking_started_at THEN 1 END ) AS cookingSampleCount,
CAST( ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ro.cooking_started_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.ready_for_pickup_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.ready_for_pickup_at >= ro.cooking_started_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, ro.cooking_started_at, ro.ready_for_pickup_at ) END ) ) AS SIGNED ) AS averageCookingSeconds,
COUNT( CASE WHEN ro.ready_for_pickup_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.picked_up_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.picked_up_at >= ro.ready_for_pickup_at THEN 1 END ) AS pickupWaitingSampleCount,
CAST( ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ro.ready_for_pickup_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.picked_up_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.picked_up_at >= ro.ready_for_pickup_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, ro.ready_for_pickup_at, ro.picked_up_at ) END ) ) AS SIGNED ) AS averagePickupWaitingSeconds,
COUNT( CASE WHEN ro.picked_up_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at >= ro.picked_up_at THEN 1 END ) AS deliverySampleCount,
CAST( ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ro.picked_up_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND ro.completed_at >= ro.picked_up_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, ro.picked_up_at, ro.completed_at ) END ) ) AS SIGNED ) AS averageDeliverySeconds
FROM report_orders ro
WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId}
AND ro.operation_status = 'COMPLETED'
AND ro.ordered_at >= #{from}
AND ro.ordered_at <= #{to}
AND ro.platform_type = #{platformType}
GROUP BY ro.platform_type
ORDER BY completedOrderCount DESC, ro.platform_type ASC
